mechanics.name: Last Stand
mechanics.currentEffect: After you spend 120/105/90 seconds in the Killer's Terror Radius while not in a Chase, Last Stand activates. While active, a Rushed Vault stuns the Killer for 3 seconds if they are within 2.5 m of the vault location. After the perk triggers, it is disabled for the remainder of the Trial.
activation: Accumulate 120/105/90 seconds in the Killer's Terror Radius while not in a Chase.
While active, perform a Rushed Vault with the Killer within 2.5 m of the vault location.
Ends/deactivates when: After its stun triggers, the perk is disabled for the remainder of the Trial.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.1.0): Introduced live with a 120/105/90-second Terror Radius charge requirement and a 3-second stun; the launch values were higher than the preceding PTB proposal.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Time spent in the Terror Radius outside Chase charges a one-use stun that can trigger on a close Rushed Vault.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: Once the effect triggers, it cannot be used again for the remainder of the Trial.

editorial.summary: After spending 90 seconds inside the Killer's Terror Radius outside chase, your next close rushed vault can stun the Killer for 3 seconds, once per Trial.
useCases: Cash the charged perk during a critical close vault to force a three-second chase swing.
Use against a Killer who repeatedly patrols near you without committing to chase.
Pair with vault-heavy chase builds so the one-use stun arrives at a meaningful moment.
counters: Ninety seconds of Terror Radius time outside chase is an enormous setup requirement.
The Killer must be within 2.5 metres of the rushed vault.
The perk disables permanently after its one successful trigger.
pros: Three-second Killer stun is a large payoff.
Can surprise the Killer at a normally unsafe close vault.
Current usage shows players do build intentionally around it.
cons: Stealth Killers can make charging much harder.
analysis: Last Stand ranks this position because a three-second stun from an ordinary rushed vault can absolutely win a chase interaction. The effect itself is not weak; the ninety-second charging requirement is what drags the perk down.

That charging time must occur inside the Terror Radius while you are not in chase. A match against a mobile or stealth Killer can make the condition painfully slow, while a territorial Killer may charge it more naturally around contested objectives.
Once ready, the perk still needs a close vault with the Killer inside 2.5 metres. Good timing can transform a near-hit into a stun and enough distance to reset the chase.
The payoff is fun and real, but a single-use perk with both a ninety-second setup and a positional trigger cannot rank on payoff alone.
editorial.verdict: A strong one-time stun buried under a marathon charging condition. Last Stand can steal a chase, but spends most of the Trial asking when the dramatic music starts.
